statements.t: For the balance of 2026, management expects a rental market with slowing rent growth.

Factors to be considered by management in its analysis of in-place lease values include an estimate of carrying costs during hypothetical expected lease-up periods considering current market conditions, and costs to execute similar leases at market rates during the expected lease-up periods, depending on local market conditions.
We intend to fund our share of the investments’ future operating deficits should the need arise.
